historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; returns decoded depth without raw 0/FFh state, device/set identity or row-geometry relationship.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds depth/position/set consistency but lowers capability for inputs.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; retained direct agent collection after operator target selection and sanity review.

original_test_intent: Validate Interleaved Data Depth for each Type 20 device as the number of consecutive rows transferred from that device, with correct non-interleaved/unknown semantics and consistency with position, set and row geometry across reboot.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 17/19/20 records, bind raw depth and position bytes to device/range identity, decode 0/FFh/version semantics, compare positive depth with approved set/factor/row geometry, and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user defines interleave depth/geometry expectations and approves reboot; no reconfiguration or physical action is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Expected interleave sets, factor and row geometry
Expected depth/position relationship per participating device
Resolved Type 17/19/20 topology and non-interleaved policy
safety_requirements: Use read-only collection; never change DIMMs, channels, interleaving, firmware or kernel.
Preserve raw depth and distinguish zero non-interleaved from FFh unknown before numeric checks.
Validate positive depth with the same device's position and complete set/row geometry, not as an isolated constant.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on contradiction or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode depth/position values, resolve device/set identity, validate positive depth against approved geometry and compare pre/post reboot.
Report unknown, inconsistent, incomplete-set or drifting depth without deciding PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve set/factor, row geometry, depth/position and sentinel policy plus reboot plan.
Interpret vendor/logical interleave behavior and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field label is correct, but grep cannot retain raw sentinel state, identify the device/set or validate depth against position and geometry.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full Type 17/19/20 data; report device/range, raw/decoded depth and position, set/factor/geometry consistency and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Interleaved Data Depth scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no interleave change is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Version-decode raw depth, resolve each device/interleave set, distinguish 0/FFh, validate positive values with position and approved row geometry, and compare after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS systems exposing Type 20 interleave data depth.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 20 Interleaved Data Depth/Position definitions and platform row geometry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw sentinel handling and relational set/position/geometry checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects Unknown-as-value and depth inconsistent with interleave position or row organization missed by grep.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Metadata validation does not prove runtime bandwidth or interleave performance; that is a separate test.

project_override_considerations: A project may define non-interleaved, partial or vendor-specific geometry, but must document 0/FFh and depth/position expectations per set; no isolated decoded depth is sufficient.
expected_evidence: Approved set/factor, row geometry, depth/position and sentinel policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 17/19/20 records with versions/lengths
Per-device/range raw/decoded depth and position plus set/geometry consistency
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Interleaved Data Depth is a valid Type 20 field; geometry and expected relations are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw decoding and relational topology comparisons are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw sentinel and depth-to-position/set/geometry validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains topology safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates missing geometry/reboot inputs and formal verdict from automation.

review_improvement: Prevents a depth label from passing when Unknown, inconsistent with its position or detached from the participating set and row geometry.
independent_technical_reasoning: Depth is relational but encoded in machine-readable topology; software can evaluate it completely once the platform geometry is supplied.
